what_this_is: A render fixture, not data. public.studio_projects holds zero rows, so the true state of /projects is the empty state and that is what run A screenshots. This row exists so run B can prove the populated path draws — the card, the CanvasStage preview, the badges and the delete control.
where_the_layers_came_from: public.studio_templates id=1 ('שיעור — מלכות'), the builtin template the product itself ships. Nothing here was drawn by hand; it is the same layers_json the editor would have opened, wrapped in the row shape that POST /api/projects stores and GET /api/projects returns (camelCase, per toProject in api/_lib/server/storage.ts).
